name: Writing
about: Posts, scripts, headlines, letters, landing pages, anything a person reads or says out loud.

criteria.question: Does it fit the audience, the channel and the goal the task states?

anchors.10: exactly right for who reads it and where
anchors.7: right, one slip in tone or length

criteria.question: Numbers, names and concrete details instead of adjectives?
Does it sound like a person: no stock phrases, no AI tells, sayable out loud if it will be spoken?

anchors.10: reads as a real person wrote it

criteria.question: No false claims and no invented facts, quotes or numbers?

anchors.10: every claim true or marked as a placeholder

criteria.question: Does the strongest thing come first and does every part earn its place?

priority.name: Say it out loud
priority.how: Read every line as if speaking it. Anything you would stumble on gets rewritten.

priority.name: One idea
priority.how: Pick the single idea the piece is for and cut everything that serves a different one.
